ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The two attached figures show the same circuit. Below is a common bottom wire; on the left side there is a 15 V voltage source, marked with the upper end positive and the lower end negative. The upper-left end is connected through a 5 Ω resistor to the middle upper node; this middle node is connected downward through a 10 Ω resistor to the bottom wire, and the voltage U is marked across this 10 Ω branch, with the positive end on top and the negative end on bottom. The middle upper node is also connected through a 2 Ω resistor to the upper-right node; on the right side there is a 3 A current source connected to the bottom wire, with the arrow upward, indicating that current is injected into the upper-right node. Reasoning: Take the bottom wire as 0 V, and calculate U according to the specified superposition method. First step, keep only the 15 V voltage source and open the 3 A current source. At this time there is no current in the 2 Ω branch, and 5 Ω and 10 Ω form a voltage divider connected across 15 V, so the contribution of the 15 V source to U is U1 = 15 × 10/(5+10) = 10 V. Second step, turn off the 15 V source, that is, replace it with a short circuit, and keep only the 3 A current source. The 3 A current on the right side is injected into the upper-right node, and must first pass through the 2 Ω resistor to reach the U node, then split between the two branches to ground, 5 Ω and 10 Ω; therefore the U node voltage equals the injected current multiplied by 5 Ω || 10 Ω. The parallel resistance is (5×10)/(5+10) = 50/15 = 10/3 Ω, so U2 = 3 × 10/3 = 10 V. The total voltage U = U1 + U2 = 10 + 10 = 20 V, retained to one decimal place is 20.0 V.

method.method_draft: Take the bottom rail as 0 V and compute U as the sum of two contributions. First keep the 15 V source active and open the 3 A current source; then no current flows through the 2 Ω resistor, so the 5 Ω and 10 Ω resistors form a divider across 15 V, giving the 15 V-source contribution to U. Second turn off the 15 V source by shorting it and keep the 3 A source active; the 3 A injected from the right must pass through the 2 Ω resistor into the U node and then split through 5 Ω and 10 Ω to ground, so the U node voltage is the injected current times 5 Ω || 10 Ω. Add the two contributions and round to one decimal place.

图像描述：两张附图显示的是同一个电路。下方是一条公共底部导线；左侧有一个15 V电压源，标注上端为正、下端为负。左上端通过一个5 Ω电阻连接到中间上节点；该中间节点向下接一个10 Ω电阻到底部导线，电压U标在这个10 Ω支路两端，正端在上、负端在下。中间上节点还通过一个2 Ω电阻连接到右上节点；右侧有一个3 A电流源接到底部导线，箭头向上，表示向右上节点注入电流。

推理：取底部导线为0 V，并按指定的叠加法计算U。第一步，只保留15 V电压源，打开3 A电流源。此时2 Ω支路无电流，5 Ω和10 Ω构成跨接在15 V上的分压器，所以15 V源对U的贡献为 U1 = 15 × 10/(5+10) = 10 V。第二步，关闭15 V源，即用短路代替它，只保留3 A电流源。右侧3 A电流被注入右上节点，必须先经过2 Ω电阻到达U节点，然后在5 Ω和10 Ω两条到地支路中分流；因此U节点电压等于注入电流乘以 5 Ω || 10 Ω。并联电阻为 (5×10)/(5+10) = 50/15 = 10/3 Ω，所以 U2 = 3 × 10/3 = 10 V。总电压 U = U1 + U2 = 10 + 10 = 20 V，保留一位小数为20.0 V。

method.method_draft: Define U as the voltage of the middle top node relative to the bottom rail. For the voltage-source-only case, open the current source and write KCL at the U node: current through 5 Ω to the known 15 V node plus current through 10 Ω to ground sums to zero; solve this equation for the contribution U_15. For the current-source-only case, short the 15 V source, introduce the right-top node voltage V_r, and write KCL equations at the U node and the right node: currents from U through 5 Ω, 10 Ω, and 2 Ω balance, while the 3 A source injects current into V_r through the 2 Ω branch. Solve for the contribution U_3. Then compute U = U_15 + U_3 and format as a one-decimal-place voltage.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：电路底部是一条公共参考导线。左侧竖支路是15 V电压源，标注上端为正、下端为负，因此左上节点相对底部为15 V。顶部左侧有5 Ω电阻连接左上节点和中间上节点；顶部右侧有2 Ω电阻连接中间上节点和右上节点。中间竖支路是10 Ω电阻，从中间上节点接到底部，电压U标注为上正下负，所以U就是中间上节点相对底部的电压。右侧竖支路是3 A电流源，箭头向上，表示电流从底部注入右上节点。推理：按指定叠加法。1) 仅保留15 V电压源时，将3 A电流源开路。中间节点U通过5 Ω接到15 V节点，通过10 Ω接地，2 Ω支路无电流。KCL为(U_15 - 15)/5 + U_15/10 = 0，解得2(U_15 - 15) + U_15 = 0，即3U_15 = 30，所以U_15 = 10 V。2) 仅保留3 A电流源时，将15 V电压源短路。设右上节点电压为V_r。中间节点KCL：U_3/5 + U_3/10 + (U_3 - V_r)/2 = 0。右上节点由电流源向上注入3 A，因此通过2 Ω流向中间节点的电流为3 A，即(V_r - U_3)/2 = 3，得到V_r = U_3 + 6。代入中间节点方程：U_3/5 + U_3/10 - 3 = 0，即0.3U_3 = 3，所以U_3 = 10 V。叠加得到U = U_15 + U_3 = 10 + 10 = 20 V，按一位小数为20.0 V。
